observation.visible_scene: Close-up of a transparent cylindrical container (jar/cup) resting on a flat surface against a dark, blurred background of rounded shapes. Inside, an opaque dark liquid fills the lower portion, with a white fluffy mass (cotton/foam-like) sitting on its jagged upper surface. Water droplets cling to the inner walls, and a rounded bright reflection is fixed on the lower-left of the container.
visible_changes: A thin vertical dark line (rod-like) first appears at the top center around frame 13 and its lower end progressively extends downward through the white mass until roughly frame 30, after which it stays in place.
The white mass deforms from one broad lobe into two rounded lobes split by the vertical line, with the central region pushed apart.
Brownish/dark fibrous strands emerge and persist at the white–dark-liquid interface near the center, growing slightly across the segment.
Small dark specks on the white surface shift slightly; the dark-liquid level, the wall droplets, the left-side highlight, and the background remain essentially unchanged.
The camera/background show no clear pan or zoom; the scene framing is static throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the vertical line actually is (solid rod, shadow, or reflection) and whether it entered before the crop.
Whether the deformation/mixing continues after the last frame.
The cause of the white mass splitting.
uncertain_details: Identity of the vertical dark line (object vs. shadow/reflection).
Possible very slight camera jitter vs. truly fixed framing.
Whether the dark-liquid surface rises marginally on the right side.
